verdict.rationale: Portkey is an API gateway with a documented REST API, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. The pack only shows a human-readable API reference and an llms.txt file, neither of which is a machine-readable API spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
